page.layout: Running head across top centre (CHRONOLOGIA, partly cut). Upper section: a narrow column of text with marginal dates and Roman numerals in the left-centre, with a column of page references at right of it; below, a ruled table of three columns (Anni mundi / Macedonum / page references), then the table continues partly at the right edge. Left margin of the scan holds fragmentary notes. Printed page numbers are not visible.; Two columns of chronological table on the page, with a narrow column of dates at left and event text beside it; a further table of Roman history with numbers and columns at lower right; the upper block is a table of Greek events with dates in the left margin columns. Running head at top right area; page number at top right.

page.notes: Left-margin fragments and the right-hand table continuing beyond the cut are not legible enough to transcribe. The running head is partly cut; the title word shown is a reading of the visible letters. Some entries in the first section are marked with a left-hand note letter that could not be confirmed. Text partly illegible at the cut edges; the Greek and fine details of the upper column are uncertain. Page number and running head read from the top right of the scan; table cells separated as printed.
